name: duopore-public-vacancy-evidence-coverage
description: See which job skills you can support with real examples and which still lack proof.
keywords: match job needs to your proof

interface.shortDescription: Match job needs to your proof
interface.longDescription: See which job skills you can support with real examples and which still lack proof. Share the job's required skill labels and your own matching evidence and sources. The tool matches the labels and shows gaps. For adults reviewing their own career facts. It does not invent experience, check the employer's claims or decide if you should be hired.
capabilities: Match job needs to your proof
defaultPrompt: Which skills in this job ad have proof in my experience?
Show the job requirements that still lack evidence.

positive.prompt: Use Vacancy Evidence Coverage with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"requiredSkills":["SQL","Presentation"],"evidence":[{"skill":"SQL","fact":"Built a SQL inventory query for a course project.","source":"Project notes"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
